mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trending_weekly (content_type, content_id, slug, title, cover_image_url, author_names, description, view_count, download_count, unique_viewers, score, rank_position, computed_at) SELECT 'BOOK', b.id, b.slug, b.title, b.cover_image_url, (SELECT STRING_AGG(a.name, ', ' ORDER BY a.name) FROM book_authors ba JOIN authors a ON ba.author_id = a.id WHERE ba.book_id = b.id), b.description, agg.view_count, agg.download_count, agg.unique_viewers, agg.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.score DESC), NOW() FROM ( SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'view') AS view_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'download') AS download_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash)) AS unique_viewers, SUM( CASE action_type WHEN 'download' THEN #{downloadWeight} WHEN 'view' THEN #{viewWeight} ELSE 0 END * POWER(2, - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - viewed_at)) / (86400.0 * #{halfLifeDays})) ) AS score FROM book_views WHERE viewed_at >= NOW() - (#{days}::text || ' days')::interval GROUP BY book_id ) agg JOIN books b ON b.id = agg.book_id AND b.is_active = true ORDER BY agg.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO trending_weekly (content_type, content_id, slug, title, cover_image_url, author_names, description, subtitle, view_count, download_count, unique_viewers, score, rank_position, computed_at) SELECT 'ZINE', z.id, z.slug, z.title, z.cover_image_url, z.first_publisher, z.description, z.subtitle, agg.view_count, agg.download_count, agg.unique_viewers, agg.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.score DESC), NOW() FROM ( SELECT zine_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'view') AS view_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'download') AS download_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash)) AS unique_viewers, SUM( CASE action_type WHEN 'download' THEN #{downloadWeight} WHEN 'view' THEN #{viewWeight} ELSE 0 END * POWER(2, - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - created_at)) / (86400.0 * #{halfLifeDays})) ) AS score FROM zine_views WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{days}::text || ' days')::interval GROUP BY zine_id ) agg JOIN zines z ON z.id = agg.zine_id AND z.is_active = true ORDER BY agg.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO trending_weekly (content_type, content_id, slug, title, cover_image_url, poster_portrait_url, release_year, description, view_count, download_count, unique_viewers, score, rank_position, computed_at) SELECT 'FILM', f.id, f.slug, f.judul, f.poster_url, f.poster_portrait_url, f.tahun_rilis, f.deskripsi, agg.view_count, agg.download_count, agg.unique_viewers, agg.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.score DESC), NOW() FROM ( SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'view') AS view_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'download') AS download_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash)) AS unique_viewers, SUM( CASE action_type WHEN 'download' THEN #{downloadWeight} WHEN 'view' THEN #{viewWeight} ELSE 0 END * POWER(2, - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - viewed_at)) / (86400.0 * #{halfLifeDays})) ) AS score FROM film_views WHERE viewed_at >= NOW() - (#{days}::text || ' days')::interval GROUP BY film_id ) agg JOIN film f ON f.id = agg.film_id ORDER BY agg.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO trending_weekly (content_type, content_id, slug, title, cover_image_url, view_count, download_count, unique_viewers, score, rank_position, computed_at) SELECT 'NEWSPAPER', ns.id, ns.slug, ns.name, ns.logo_url, agg.view_count, agg.download_count, agg.unique_viewers, agg.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.score DESC), NOW() FROM ( SELECT na.source_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE av.action_type::text = 'view') AS view_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE av.action_type::text = 'download') AS download_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(av.user_id::text, av.viewer_hash)) AS unique_viewers, SUM( CASE av.action_type::text WHEN 'download' THEN #{downloadWeight} WHEN 'view' THEN #{viewWeight} ELSE 0 END * POWER(2, - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - av.created_at)) / (86400.0 * #{halfLifeDays})) ) AS score FROM article_views av JOIN newspaper_articles na ON na.id = av.article_id AND na.is_active = true WHERE av.created_at >= NOW() - (#{days}::text || ' days')::interval GROUP BY na.source_id ) agg JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON ns.id = agg.source_id AND ns.is_active = true ORDER BY agg.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE trending_weekly t SET normalized_score = CASE WHEN m.max_score > 0 THEN t.score / m.max_score ELSE 0 END FROM ( SELECT content_type, MAX(score) AS max_score FROM trending_weekly GROUP BY content_type ) m WHERE t.content_type = m.content_type
mapper.select: SELECT content_type AS contentType, content_id AS contentId, slug, title, subtitle, cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, poster_portrait_url AS posterPortraitUrl, author_names AS authorNames, release_year AS releaseYear, description, source_slug AS sourceSlug, view_count AS viewCount, download_count AS downloadCount, unique_viewers AS uniqueViewers, score, normalized_score AS normalizedScore, rank_position AS rankPosition, computed_at AS computedAt FROM trending_weekly WHERE content_type = #{contentType} ORDER BY rank_position ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT content_type AS contentType, content_id AS contentId, slug, title, subtitle, cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, poster_portrait_url AS posterPortraitUrl, author_names AS authorNames, release_year AS releaseYear, description, source_slug AS sourceSlug, view_count AS viewCount, download_count AS downloadCount, unique_viewers AS uniqueViewers, score, normalized_score AS normalizedScore, rank_position AS rankPosition, computed_at AS computedAt FROM trending_weekly WHERE rank_position <= #{limitPerType} ORDER BY content_type ASC, rank_position ASC

SELECT content_type AS contentType, content_id AS contentId, slug, title, subtitle, cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, poster_portrait_url AS posterPortraitUrl, author_names AS authorNames, release_year AS releaseYear, description, source_slug AS sourceSlug, view_count AS viewCount, download_count AS downloadCount, unique_viewers AS uniqueViewers, score, normalized_score AS normalizedScore, rank_position AS rankPosition, computed_at AS computedAt FROM trending_weekly ORDER BY normalized_score DESC, score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
